title: Smoke harness: 1 sample to 1 caller (STAR-Fusion) to normalised calls to scored, with provenance
context: M0 end-to-end smoke harness for the EWSR1-fusion detection benchmark. It proves the whole spine works: one simulated sample runs through one pinned caller, output is normalised to FusionCall, scored against ground truth, and bound to a provenance ledger. Determinism and complete provenance are the core integrity guarantees of the project; no patient data is involved.
objective: Implement the smoke harness running the sim-004 sample through STAR-Fusion (pinned digest), normalising to FusionCall, scoring against ground truth, and emitting a provenance-bound metrics record.
acceptanceCriteria: One simulated EWSR1-FLI1 sample runs through STAR-Fusion (pinned digest) end-to-end.
Output normalised to FusionCall; scored against ground truth; metrics emitted.
Provenance ledger binds the score to input hash + container digest + params + commit.
Re-running produces identical results (deterministic or seeded); reviewed by bio-rev + maint.
output: A pull request adding the smoke harness pipeline (sample -> STAR-Fusion -> FusionCall -> scored) with the provenance ledger.
